reasoning: This icon depicts a magnifying glass with a minus sign, the universal UI chrome glyph for 'zoom out'. Because zooming out is an interface action rather than a real-world task subject (outside of rare software development tasks building zoom controls), it has very poor task fit and mainly risks being confused with general search, a physical magnifying glass, or the Zoom video app.
